_comment: Behavioural expectations for `node scripts/checks/sanity-request-count.mjs --live-reads`: NOS host, GET /tickets/<slug> twice against the stubbed production server (SITE_PUBLIC_LAUNCH=true). The stub answers every Sanity query with result null, so the page 404s after its reads; the three live reads below run before the notFound(), on every request. Each read is matched by identity, not by substring: `name` is the export in sanity/queries.ts, and the check compares the sha256 of that query's whitespace-collapsed text with the `qh=` field sanity-count-preload.mjs writes in a fixed position (third space-separated field, before any query text) on every count-log line (PR #160 Codex findings). `fingerprint` is kept as a drift check: it must be a substring of the whitespace-collapsed export text, or the check stops with a setup error.

second_request_must_not_contain.name: ticketsPageQuery
second_request_must_not_contain.reason: positive control: the one NON-live read on this page is served from the data cache on the second request, proving the harness tells a cached read from a live one

covers: page.tsx:108, page.tsx:109 and ticket-type-lookup.ts at runtime. page.tsx:168 and loadTicketCardViewModels need a ticketType document and a purchasable state, which the null stub cannot produce; they are covered by the AST check (buy-path-live-reads.mts) and mutations M3 and M6-M8.
